commit_message: Expose Timeline assets through the Asset Browser
pr_title: GameEngine: complete ADR 0126 Timeline / Sequencer first release
pr_body:
## Summary

Exposes canonical .timeline.json assets in the Asset Browser, makes them registerable, and routes Open/double-click to the ADR 0126 Sequencer while preserving the existing workspace-document boundary.
